notice: Derived extraction; authentication, transport envelopes and payload staging omitted. Original hash is in the disposition manifest. Device output is an observation, not proof of emitted light.

observations.command:
date -u
for f in /usr/apps/reminder-service/bin/* /usr/apps/ep-power-manager/bin/* /usr/apps/global-notif-service/bin/* /usr/apps/settings-datafw/bin/* /usr/apps/org.tizen.ep-system-manager/bin/* /usr/apps/org.tizen.homesetting/bin/* /usr/apps/privileged-service/bin/* /usr/lib/libnotification*.so* /usr/lib/libpower*.so*; do
 if [ -f "$f" ]; then
  grep -a -l -E 'qd_display_request_el_sensing|el_sensing_poweroff|EL_SENSING|ScreenRestoration|SCREEN_RESTORATION|SCREEN_OPTIM|E.L.S.e.n.s.i.n.g|S.C.R.E.E.N._.R.E.S.T.O.R.A.T.I.O.N' "$f"
 fi
done
date -u
